prompt:
﻿# genui_gen_v4_compact

You are a GenUICraft generator.
Convert the RESPONSE text into valid GenUICraft v0.9 server-to-client messages.

RESPONSE:
Your Monthly Budget Analysis

Icons:
- Finance: https://uxwing.com/wp-content/themes/uxwing/download/brands-social-media/finance-icon.png
- Savings: https://uxwing.com/wp-content/themes/uxwing/download/money-currency/piggy-bank-icon.png

Your Monthly Budget Overview:

Category             | Amount
---------------------|-----------
Rent                 | $2,100
Groceries            | $650
Dining Out           | $400
Utilities            | $280
Internet             | $80
Streaming Services   | $120
Gym                  | $100
Transportation       | $350
Miscellaneous        | $200
---------------------|-----------
Total Monthly Expenses | $4,280

Savings Goal:
Based on your budget, we've identified three areas where you can save at least $200 per month without significantly impacting essential needs.

Three Areas to Save:

Option 1: Dining Out
  Summary: Reduce dining out expenses by focusing on home-cooked meals and packed lunches.
  Potential Savings: $100 (reducing from $400 to $300)
  Actionable Tip: Plan to cook at home more often. Consider packing your lunch for work/school at least 2-3 times a week instead of buying it.

Option 2: Streaming Services
  Summary: Evaluate and optimize your streaming subscriptions to cut unnecessary costs.
  Potential Savings: $50 (reducing from $120 to $70)
  Actionable Tip: Review all active subscriptions. Cancel any services you rarely use, or consider rotating services month-to-month. Look into ad-supported tiers if available and suitable.

Option 3: Groceries
  Summary: Implement smarter grocery shopping habits to reduce your weekly spend.
  Potential Savings: $50 (reducing from $650 to $600)
  Actionable Tip: Create a weekly meal plan before you shop, make a detailed grocery list, and stick to it to avoid impulse purchases. Compare prices and buy generic brands for staples.

Total Potential Savings: $100 + $50 + $50 = $200

Quick Actions:
[Button: Create a Detailed Budget Plan] https://www.example.com/budget-template
[Button: Find Meal Planning Resources] https://www.example.com/meal-planning-tips
[Button: Compare Streaming Services] https://www.example.com/streaming-comparison

Output contract:
- Output ONLY a JSON array (no markdown, no prose).
- Each array item must be one v0.9 message object.
- Allowed message types only: `createSurface`, `updateComponents`, `updateDataModel`, `deleteSurface`.
- Add `createSurface` before any updates.
- `createSurface.catalogId` must be `https://genui.local/specification/v0_9/standard_catalog.json`.
- Include exactly one `updateComponents` message with a complete component set.
- In that set, include exactly one component with `id: "root"` as tree root.
- Component ids must be unique; all child references must resolve.
- Use only catalog-supported components and properties.

Component guidance:
- Prefer structured UI over text dumps.
- Use `Card`, `Row`, `Column`, `List`, `Tabs`, `Divider`, `Button` where appropriate.
- Convert action-like links/"Quick Actions" to `Button` with `action.functionCall.call = "openUrl"`.
- Preserve key content (assumptions, options, comparisons, totals, sources) without hallucination.
- If dynamic rows are useful, use `updateDataModel` + template children binding.

Assets and URLs:
- For media, use only local asset paths that start with `/`.
- Never output remote image/icon URLs.
- For web actions, `openUrl` targets may be remote URLs.

Validation reminders:
- `version` must be `"v0.9"` on every message.
- `updateComponents.components` must be a non-empty array.
- Keep JSON strictly valid.
